text: Brigid, here's the supply sack Wren asked me to carry. I give it to her, then stand clear so Wren can see Tam. Does the letter go to you or to Maren?
intent_before_narration: Deliver the identified sack, ask about letter; stay available.

text: Brigid, please have Tam's thumb-ring back. I give it to her, then help Serra bring the broth to the bedside if she'd like a hand.
intent_before_narration: Return the actual loan to Brigid and join an ordinary short indoor errand if accepted.

text: Thank you, Brigid. May I come sit by the hearth and hear what Mother Wren thinks? I have no wish to crowd the bed.
intent_before_narration: Accept invitation to enter and ask to go as far as the hearth, avoid bedside.

text: Brigid, are you expecting someone? I tell her about the pair of prints before I touch a thing. I'll stay by the fire with Tam for now.
intent_before_narration: Ask about a possible visitor and expressly remain indoors.

text: I'd like a place to sleep until morning. Would you show me where I may lay my cloak? I can look for Maren after breakfast.
intent_before_narration: Accept a local guide to an ordinary sleeping place, postpone search for Maren.

text: Brigid, I'll take the bread for the road, thank you. I'm happy to tell Maren how his son is doing, but keep your silver. Where do the drovers usually make camp?
intent_before_narration: Accept bread only, decline the fee explicitly, ask for directions before traveling.

text: Yes, Dann, I'd like your company. Would you lead me to the drovers' ford after breakfast? I'll carry the bread in case we need to split it on the way.
intent_before_narration: Accept the guide and request a joint walk to the ford after breakfast; no fee or transfer yet.

text: He's alive. Wren is with him and he's breathing easier. I offer Maren a piece of my road bread while he catches his breath.
intent_before_narration: Report witnessed condition, offer part of bread; no compulsory departure.

text: Then I'll take the east road to the drovers' ford myself. I put the bread back in my pouch for the journey.
intent_before_narration: Explicitly travel from the actual farm to the ford, keep bread.

text: I stop beside Dann and follow his gaze. What exactly is moving downriver? I'm not stepping into the water.
intent_before_narration: Observe from a standstill at the interruption; do not cross.

text: No, I haven't. I won't take either of us down there blind. I'll stay beside you on the rise and call a warning toward the cattle pens.
intent_before_narration: End the excursion on the safe overlook, warn the drovers without entering the marsh or starting a fight.
